summary.en: The thread arc: one line becomes everything in turn: it types the brief, the word swings, the tool's steps are shown link by link, the line floods into the film's own contact sheet, and it is cut into the name and types the URL.
summary.zh: thread 的骨架：一条线依次变成一切：敲出需求、大字摆动、工具的步骤一环一环展示、线色泛成片子自己的样片表，最后被切成产品名并敲出网址。

fits: Reels of video, motion and rendering tools, 12–45 s.
notFor: Any other subject; more than six steps; steps that cannot each be shown by one link.

intent.en: Tell the tool's pipeline as one unbroken transformation, each link a step it really performs.
intent.zh: 把工具的流程讲成一次不断的变形，每一环都是它真做的一步。

content.en: A brief, a word, about six named steps with a note each, a counter label, a name, a line and a URL.
content.zh: 一句需求、一个词、大约六个有名字和注释的步骤、计数标签、产品名、结束语和网址。

fits.zh: 12–45 秒的视频、动效、渲染工具作品集。

notFor.zh: 其他任何主题；超过六步；不能各用一环展示的步骤。

en: The order is fixed; leave out the head or the tail only as wholes (storyboard → merge → close is the shortest, 6 bars).
zh: 顺序固定；开头或结尾只能整段去掉（分镜 → 合并 → 收尾最短，6 小节）。

source.path: assets/templates/thread/content.js; film.js REGISTRY; references/modes/thread.md (Scenes, Use cases)

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead against the original template's scene order and lengths (card, Differs from upstream)
